art_version_or_none: none (art_brief v1: no_art_required=true, no scene image used -- emoji/icon/CSS only, matching legacy-move-try/legacy-allocate-and-forecast's non-image UI pattern. The existing public/assets/schooltrip/school-trip-hotel.jpg was independently visually verified via the Read tool and found to depict the OLD mechanic (manual room-grid placement, bath-time-slot clocks); it is deliberately NOT reused since it would visually suggest operations that no longer exist in this redesign)
d_preserved_statement: The reviewed mechanic (t1-check-in-per-group, design review r2 PASS 88) is preserved exactly: for each of 3 groups (花組/月組/雪組, drawn from the shared tripBands.ts roster for cross-game continuity), the child must open both the size/proposed-room card and the per-member allergy card (disclosure gate enforced via `allRead`, verified by gameplay-qa-hotel-receive.mjs), then commit ONE room-sufficiency verdict (accept/reject the proposed room's capacity against the group's actual size) and the exact SET of members needing 個別対応食 (matching design-sim.mjs's `groupWin`/`sessionWin` byte-for-byte in src/q1/hotelReceiveLogic.ts) in a single per-group commit (no retry, closing the brute_force reverse-audit finding). Gate H (onComplete only when sessionWin is true across all 3 groups, onPartialComplete otherwise with a third distinct failure icon state) and Gate G (non-scored reflection re-presenting all 3 groups' original data read-only, continue button gated on every group having a reflection pick) are both implemented and verified via source-level regression checks. The old implementation's decorative 'rest need' datum is not reintroduced in any form (verified by a dedicated regression check for the relevant substrings). Browser-verified end-to-end via the Q1 shell: both the full-success path (🎉 celebratory framing) and the partial-failure path (🤔 honest, distinct framing + reflection screen) render and behave correctly with real randomized session data.
